reviewer: Codex visual inspection of rendered image and requested detail crops

criteria.evidence: The head and green flame have the sharpest local contrast, while the muted landscape remains subordinate and readable.
Warm near-wing paint, cool far-wing shadows, restrained canvas texture and broken landscape brushwork share a consistent muted palette with the green focal accent.

strengths: The bright green fire and detailed skull lead the eye; curved brushwork and slight edge irregularity better integrate the creature with the painted hills.
weaknesses: The near wing remains stiff, teeth and claws are conspicuously geometric, and the scene is closer to a stylized fantasy illustration with oil brushwork than an accomplished traditional oil painting. Further art-direction trials are needed before claiming excellent arbitrary art.
